label: Words: My firm and Firm approvals
aliases: words: my firm and firm approvals

params.name: lede
params.default: Your firm's details, papers and team. Filing opens once the portal admin approves the firm.
params.label: lede

params.name: lede_new
params.default: Start here. Who is signing up? Pick one - you give the details and papers next, and the portal admin approves.
params.label: lede new

params.name: privacy
params.default: Your papers are seen only by the portal admin, to verify your firm. Only the last 4 digits of Aadhaar are kept - upload the masked e-Aadhaar.
params.label: privacy

params.name: papers_hint
params.default: PDF or a photo ({exts}), up to {mb} MB each.
params.label: papers hint

params.name: consent
params.default: I confirm these details and papers are true and belong to this firm, and I agree the portal admin may verify them (and, later, through DigiLocker).
params.label: consent

params.name: submit_body
params.default: The portal admin checks your details and papers, usually within {hours} hours. You cannot change them while they wait.
params.label: submit body

params.name: st_draft
params.default: Fill in the details, upload the papers, then send them for approval.
params.label: st draft

params.name: st_submitted
params.default: Sent on {at}. The portal admin reviews within {hours} hours; you will get an email.
params.label: st submitted

params.name: st_returned
params.default: The portal admin asked for a fix (below). Change what is asked, then send again.
params.label: st returned

params.name: st_approved
params.default: Your firm is approved. Filing is open; add your team below.
params.label: st approved

params.name: st_rejected
params.default: The application was not approved (reason below). Write to the portal admin if you think this is wrong.
params.label: st rejected

params.name: st_suspended
params.default: Your firm is suspended (reason below). Filing is closed until the portal admin restores it.
params.label: st suspended

params.name: team_after
params.default: You can add your team once the firm is approved.
params.label: team after

params.name: add_hint
params.default: They get a one-time password (by email when mail is set up, else shown to you once) and set their own at first sign-in.
params.label: add hint

params.name: added_pw
params.default: Give {email} this one-time password. It is shown only now; they choose their own at first sign-in.
params.label: added pw

params.name: added_mail
params.default: Added - {email} has the sign-in details by email.
params.label: added mail

params.name: remove_body
params.default: They lose access to the firm's clients at once. Their account stays.
params.label: remove body

params.name: owner_lede
params.default: Firms are run by their own admins. As the portal admin you approve them.
params.label: owner lede

params.name: owner_body
params.default: Your own clients stay in your house register (Clients & years). Firms that sign up wait for you in Firm approvals.
params.label: owner body

params.name: owner_house
params.default: The portal admin keeps the house register and does not join a firm.
params.label: owner house

params.name: ap_lede
params.default: Firms waiting for you, oldest first. The promise is {hours} hours.
params.label: ap lede

params.name: ap_note_hint
params.default: Needed to return, reject or suspend - say what to fix.
params.label: ap note hint

params.name: ap_checklist
params.default: Check: the PAN's name matches the firm; the GSTIN carries the same PAN; the TAN letter names the firm; the Aadhaar is masked and the owner's; call the phone to confirm it is linked.
params.label: ap checklist

params.name: m_returned
params.default: Returned to the firm for a fix.
params.label: m returned

params.name: bad_move
params.default: That step is not possible now.
params.label: bad move

params.name: has_firm
params.default: You already belong to a firm.
params.label: has firm

params.name: bad_kind
params.default: Pick a CA firm or Individual / HUF.
params.label: bad kind

params.name: no_firm
params.default: You do not belong to a firm yet - start in My firm.
params.label: no firm

params.name: role_no
params.default: Your role in the firm does not allow this.
params.label: role no

params.name: firm_wait
params.default: Your firm is not approved yet ({state}). Filing opens once the portal admin approves it - see My firm.
params.label: firm wait

params.name: not_editable
params.default: The application is with the portal admin; it cannot change now.
params.label: not editable

params.name: bad_ext
params.default: Upload a PDF or a photo ({exts}).
params.label: bad ext

params.name: bad_doc
params.default: This kind of account has no such paper.
params.label: bad doc

params.name: need_note
params.default: Write a note to the firm saying why.
params.label: need note

params.name: no_member
params.default: No such person in your firm.
params.label: no member

params.name: client_room
params.default: This account files for {n} {n:client|clients} - itself. A CA firm account files for many.
params.label: client room

params.name: last_admin
params.default: The firm must keep at least one firm admin.
params.label: last admin

params.name: need_consent
params.default: Tick the confirmation at the end of the details.
params.label: need consent

params.name: pan_letter
params.default: The PAN's 4th letter does not fit this kind of account (F for a firm or LLP, P for a person, H for a HUF).
params.label: pan letter

params.name: gstin_pan
params.default: The GSTIN does not carry this PAN (characters 3-12).
params.label: gstin pan

params.name: mail_submitted_body
params.default: {firm} sent its details and papers. Please review within {hours} hours (Firm approvals).
params.label: mail submitted body

params.name: mail_welcome_body
params.default:
{who} added you to {firm} as {role}.

Sign in at {url} with {email} and the one-time password {password}. You will choose your own password.
params.label: mail welcome body

params.name: bad_pan
params.default: The PAN is not right. 10 characters, e.g. AAFFP1234C.
params.label: bad pan

params.name: bad_tan
params.default: The TAN is not right. 10 characters, e.g. HYDP12345E.
params.label: bad tan

params.name: bad_gstin
params.default: The GSTIN is not right. 15 characters; carries the PAN.
params.label: bad gstin

params.name: h_frn
params.default: 6 digits and the region letter, e.g. 012345S.
params.label: h frn

params.name: need_frn
params.default: Give the ICAI firm registration no. (FRN).
params.label: need frn

params.name: bad_frn
params.default: The ICAI firm registration no. (FRN) is not right. 6 digits and the region letter, e.g. 012345S.
params.label: bad frn

params.name: bad_membership_no
params.default: The CA membership no. is not right. 6 digits.
params.label: bad membership no

params.name: h_owner_name
params.default: The person signing up for the firm.
params.label: h owner name

params.name: need_owner_name
params.default: Give the Owner / partner in charge.
params.label: need owner name

params.name: h_aadhaar_last4
params.default: Only the last 4 digits - never the full number.
params.label: h aadhaar last4

params.name: bad_aadhaar_last4
params.default: The Aadhaar - last 4 digits is not right. Only the last 4 digits - never the full number.
params.label: bad aadhaar last4

params.name: h_phone
params.default: 10 digits; the one registered with the income-tax / GST portal.
params.label: h phone

params.name: need_phone
params.default: Give the Mobile linked to PAN / GST.
params.label: need phone

params.name: bad_phone
params.default: The Mobile linked to PAN / GST is not right. 10 digits; the one registered with the income-tax / GST portal.
params.label: bad phone

params.name: h_email
params.default: Mail about the approval comes here.
params.label: h email

params.name: bad_email
params.default: The Email is not right. Mail about the approval comes here.
params.label: bad email
